name: JobTrackr
description: Self-hosted job-application tracker: a Kanban board for your job search, with resume storage, contacts, follow-up reminders, and an analytics view. Connects to a PostgreSQL database that you already run (no database is included). The database connection is configured from the web UI on first launch.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for the saved database connection (setup.json) and uploaded resumes. Keep this mapped or you will lose both on update.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the JobTrackr web interface.
